requirements.complexity: stage limits per batch of 16 cases (3 CPU s, 8 s wall, 1 GiB, 64 MB V8 heap); finite tests, not a complexity proof
requirements.denominator: all 500 stay in the M1 denominator whatever later measurement finds
requirements.numeric: exact integers; unsafe Number outputs fail closed; BigInt where the transport requires it
requirements.oracle: unchanged return oracle on every corpus case (qualify_rules.judge_case), with the declared transport and adapter
requirements.parity: a successor source must match the admitted source's recorded result, result type, arguments after the call and alias edges on every case
